newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga says 1996 net 123.6 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga says 1996 net 123.6 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian toll road builder and operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada had net profit of 123.6 billion rupiah in 1996, the company's finance director Tito Sulistio said on Monday.
He forecast net profit of 145 billion rupiah for 1997.
"Citra Marga posted a net profit of 123.6 billion rupiah in 1996. We expect a net profit of 145 billion rupiah in 1997," he told an economic conference organised by ING Baring Securities Indonesia.
Net profit in 1995 was 94 billion rupiah.
Citra Marga is headed by President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hardiyanti Rukmana.
